review_scope: All translation keys checked by the content auditor; all ten English and localized titles, flagged source/target pairs, and two deterministic long-passage samples reviewed. Currency insertions in numeric examples and escaped markup checked separately.

reviewed_flags.resolution: The Croatian answer correctly asks for currency codes at quote and payment, plus disclosed exchange rates and fees.
The Croatian computation retains 75 yuan, 10.00 plus 1.30, proportional fees and hypothetical status.
The sampled request correctly asks about charges for testing another arrangement and specifies retaining the insert under the shipping limit.
The sample correctly calls for linking the resolved charge to a dated earlier packing confirmation and amount.

corrections.source: Multiply kilograms by 1,000 to enter grams. A parcel measured at 1.35 kg is 1,350 g. Keep length, width and height in centimetres on the same worksheet.
corrections.translation: Za unos u gramima pomnožite kilograme s 1000. Ako paket teži 1,35 kg, unesite 1350 g. Na istom listu duljinu, širinu i visinu navedite u centimetrima.

corrections.source: Only if the items will actually be packed end to end. Decide on the proposed arrangement and measure its outer envelope. Leave room for protective material and confirm packed dimensions later.
corrections.translation: Samo ako ćete proizvode zaista složiti u jedan red, jedan iza drugoga. Odaberite raspored, izmjerite ukupne vanjske dimenzije, predvidite prostor za zaštitu i nakon pakiranja provjerite konačne mjere.

corrections.source: Write down the exact service, amount and whether it applies to an item or parcel. Check if a quoted total already includes it before adding it separately.
corrections.translation: Zapišite naziv usluge i iznos te naplaćuje li se po artiklu ili po paketu. Prije nego što iznos zasebno pribrojite, provjerite je li već uključen u ukupan iznos ponude.

corrections.source: Suppose one shop supplies two T-shirts at 68 yuan each and a cap at 42 yuan. The checkout shows a single domestic charge of 10 yuan. The seller order totals 188 yuan. Three separate rows in your shortlist should not turn that into three charges of 10. Keep the 10 on a summary line until you have a reason to calculate the cost of an individual piece. Record who collected the payment and which seller order number appears beside it.
corrections.translation: Pretpostavimo da kupujete dvije majice po 68 juana i kapu za 42 juana u istoj trgovini. Na blagajni se za cijelu narudžbu obračunava jedna domaća dostava od 10 juana, pa narudžba ukupno iznosi 188 juana. Tri retka u vašoj tablici ne znače da dostavu od 10 trebate zaračunati tri puta. Zadržite je u zbirnom retku dok vam ne zatreba trošak po artiklu. Zapišite primatelja uplate i broj narudžbe koji stoji uz nju.

corrections.source: If two people share the order, agreeing on a split matters more than producing a falsely precise cost per item. A simple split across three units gives approximately 3.33 yuan per piece with a one-cent rounding adjustment. Another method assigns the 10 in proportion to product value. Each 68-yuan shirt gets about 3.82 and the cap about 2.36. Both methods reproduce 188. Neither method can establish the seller's actual transport cost for the cap.
corrections.translation: Ako dvije osobe dijele narudžbu, važnije je unaprijed dogovoriti ključ raspodjele nego stvoriti privid točnog troška po artiklu. Ravnomjernom raspodjelom dostave na tri artikla svakome pripada oko 3,33 juana, uz prilagodbu od 0,01 juana zbog zaokruživanja. Ako 10 juana raspodijelite razmjerno cijeni robe, svakoj majici od 68 juana pripada oko 3,82, a kapi oko 2,36. U oba slučaja cijela narudžba stoji 188 juana. Ni iz jedne raspodjele ne možete utvrditi stvarni trošak koji je prodavatelj imao za prijevoz kape.

corrections.source: Consider a buyer choosing between two offers for the same packs of plain socks. Shop Green lists the selected packs at 24 yuan each and shows 8 yuan domestic delivery for the order. Shop Blue lists them at 26 each with domestic delivery included in the displayed checkout. At a quantity of one, Green costs 32 and Blue costs 26. At a quantity of three, the totals are 80 and 78. At a quantity of four, both cost 104. These break-even figures assume the prices and delivery conditions remain fixed as quantity changes. Open each checkout again at the intended quantity before basing a purchase on the calculation.
corrections.translation: Dvije trgovine nude jednaka pakiranja običnih čarapa. Trgovina Green za svako traži 24 juana i još 8 juana za dostavu cijele narudžbe. U trgovini Blue pakiranje stoji 26 juana s uključenom domaćom dostavom. Za jedno pakiranje plaćate 32 odnosno 26 juana. Za tri pakiranja iznosi su 80 odnosno 78, a za četiri obje ponude iznose 104. Izračun vrijedi samo ako se s promjenom količine ne promijene cijene ili uvjeti dostave. Prije kupnje na obje blagajne provjerite stvarnu željenu količinu.

corrections.source: Consider a hypothetical worksheet with three product entries, two inner cartons and one outer parcel. Assume the quoted service is 4 yuan per inner carton and an outer-packing option costs 7 yuan for the parcel. The worksheet should add 8 and 7, or 15 in total. Multiplying both charges by three because there are three item rows produces 33. This example illustrates the arithmetic only; read the actual service units and amounts on the live offer.
corrections.translation: Zamislite tablicu s tri artikla, dvije unutarnje kutije i jednim vanjskim paketom. Ako usluga za unutarnju kutiju stoji 4 juana po kutiji, a dodatno vanjsko pakiranje 7 juana po paketu, zbroj je 8 + 7 = 15 juana. Pomnožite li obje naknade s tri samo zato što su u tablici tri artikla, pogrešno ćete dobiti 33. Primjer prikazuje samo način računanja. Iznose i jedinice naplate provjerite u stvarnoj ponudi.

corrections.source: Suppose the confirmed unit prices are 80, 94 and 80 yuan and the order has one 9-yuan domestic charge. The merchandise total is 254 and the order total is 263. If the payment request shows 269, inspect its components before calling the extra six a service charge. The seller may have changed the price of one variant, added an explicit charge or applied a different quantity. Compare each option, quantity and line subtotal in order. A three-line purchase is small enough to reconcile without guessing which part changed.
corrections.translation: Pretpostavimo da su potvrđene cijene artikala 80, 94 i 80 juana, a domaća dostava stoji 9 juana za cijelu narudžbu. Roba ukupno stoji 254 juana, a narudžba s dostavom 263. Ako zahtjev za plaćanje glasi na 269, provjerite stavke prije nego što razliku od šest juana proglasite naknadom za uslugu. Možda se promijenila cijena jedne varijante ili količina, ili je prodavatelj izričito naveo novu naknadu. Redom usporedite odabrane varijante, količine i međuzbrojeve.

corrections.source: Imagine a teaching example in which one home-currency unit buys 7.20 yuan. A 360-yuan quote corresponds to 50 units before fees because 360 is divided by 7.20. If you instead record the rate as home units per yuan, multiply by that number. Write out both currency codes with the rate. A single bare value such as 7.20 is especially easy to use backwards when a sheet mixes several quotations.
corrections.translation: Zamislite da se za jednu jedinicu vaše valute može kupiti 7,20 juana. Ponuda od 360 juana vrijedi 50 jedinica vaše valute prije naknada jer se 360 dijeli sa 7,20. Ako tečaj zapišete obratno, kao broj jedinica vaše valute za jedan juan, iznos u juanima pomnožite tim brojem. Uz tečaj zapišite obje valutne oznake. Kod više ponuda lako je pogrešno primijeniti broj poput 7,20 bez oznaka.

corrections.source: Sometimes a buyer needs a planning figure before the exact transaction rate is known. Show a sensitivity range using clearly labelled hypothetical rates instead of presenting a single amount as guaranteed. For a 450-yuan amount, 7.50 yuan per home unit produces 60.00, while 7.20 produces 62.50, before any additional charges. That 2.50 spread identifies how much the assumption matters for this hypothetical budget. It does not predict the rate available at checkout.
corrections.translation: Za planiranje ponekad trebate procjenu prije nego što saznate tečaj plaćanja. Navedite raspon uz jasno označene pretpostavke. Za kupnju od 450 juana, pri tečaju od 7,50 juana za jedinicu vaše valute platili biste 60,00 takvih jedinica, a pri tečaju od 7,20 iznos bi bio 62,50, prije dodatnih naknada. Razlika od 2,50 pokazuje utjecaj pretpostavke na ovaj proračun. Stvarni tečaj provjerite pri plaćanju.

corrections.source: Keep the final parcel statement next to your selected services and measured outer dimensions. If the outbound charge changes, compare the final dimensions with the size assumed earlier. If the invoice shows an additional service, identify which piece and which instruction it corresponds to. If there is no clear match, ask support to explain the line and supply the quote you were comparing.
corrections.translation: Uz konačni obračun pošiljke čuvajte odabrane usluge i izmjerene vanjske dimenzije. Promijeni li se cijena međunarodnog prijevoza, usporedite konačne mjere s prethodnom procjenom. Ako na računu postoji dodatna usluga, pronađite artikl i uputu za pakiranje na koje se odnosi. Ako to nije jasno, pošaljite podršci ponudu s kojom uspoređujete račun i zamolite za objašnjenje te stavke.

corrections.source: Take an example of an empty carton whose inside is labelled 35 by 25 by 15 centimetres. After loading it and applying protection, the outside measures 36 by 26 by 17. The inside rectangular volume is 13,125 cubic centimetres. The outside rectangular volume is 15,912, a difference of 2,787. This discrepancy can arise without adding a second product. The box walls, the lid and a bulging section can all matter to the outer measurement.
corrections.translation: Uzmimo praznu kutiju unutarnjih dimenzija 35 × 25 × 15 centimetara. Nakon umetanja robe i zaštite vanjske dimenzije iznose 36 × 26 × 17 centimetara. Unutarnja pravokutna zapremina iznosi 13 125 kubičnih centimetara, a vanjska 15 912, što je razlika od 2787 kubičnih centimetara. Do nje može doći i bez drugog proizvoda. Debljina stijenki, poklopac i izbočenja utječu na vanjske mjere.

corrections.source: The two numbers answer different questions. Internal volume helps you reason about what might fit. External volume describes the space the packed box occupies. For a route comparison based on outer dimensions, keep the latter. The percentage change in geometric volume is about 21 percent, yet it would be a mistake to predict a 21 percent change in freight. The current route defines the billing method and restrictions. A volume comparison is a measurement exercise, not a complete price calculation.
corrections.translation: Unutarnja zapremina govori koliko mjesta ima za sadržaj, a vanjska koliko mjesta zauzima zapakirana kutija. Za usporedbu dostave prema vanjskim dimenzijama koristite vanjsku zapreminu. U primjeru je ona oko 21 posto veća od unutarnje. Iz toga ne slijedi da će i prijevoz biti skuplji 21 posto. Cijena i ograničenja ovise o pravilima odabrane dostave. Sama usporedba zapremina nije potpuni izračun troška.

corrections.source: Turn one unknown into one support question. Instead of asking whether the whole estimate is correct, specify that you entered a named destination and measured parcel, received a quote for a particular route, and need to know whether the selected packing service is already inside the displayed total. Save the answer with the date and the quote version. Avoid applying a reply about one route to a different service with different terms.
corrections.translation: Za svaku nejasnoću postavite konkretno pitanje. Navedite odredište, izmjerene podatke paketa i rutu za koju ste dobili ponudu te pitajte je li odabrana usluga pakiranja uključena u prikazani iznos. Odgovor spremite uz datum i verziju ponude. Ako druga ruta ima drukčije uvjete, odgovor nemojte automatski primijeniti na nju.

corrections.source: If a difference remains, identify the charge and both records where you expected it to match. For example, ask which input changed the base freight between a named quote and a named parcel. Include the route, measurement date and currency, and omit unrelated payment details. HubBuy's public support page lists parcel submission, orders and shipping among its support topics. Use that channel for an explanation specific to your account.
corrections.translation: Ostane li razlika, navedite stavku i oba dokumenta u kojima ste očekivali jednak iznos. Pitajte, primjerice, koji je podatak promijenio osnovnu cijenu prijevoza između određene ponude i konačnog obračuna paketa. Navedite rutu, datum mjerenja i valutu, a izostavite nepovezane podatke o plaćanju. Na javnoj stranici podrške HubBuyja među temama su predaja paketa, narudžbe i dostava. Tim kanalom zatražite objašnjenje za svoj račun.

corrections.source: Suppose quote A covers the same merchandise and domestic delivery as quote B, but only A includes protective packing. Compare the contents before worrying about exchange-rate rounding. Either add the confirmed packing amount to B or label the quotes as different offers. If a missing charge has no confirmed amount, leave a gap instead of filling it with an attractive guess. A conversion cannot repair two quotes that describe different services.
corrections.translation: Pretpostavimo da ponude A i B obuhvaćaju istu robu i domaću dostavu, ali samo A uključuje zaštitno pakiranje. Prije usporedbe zaokruživanja tečaja utvrdite što svaka ponuda uključuje. Potvrđenu cijenu zaštite dodajte ponudi B ili označite da se ponude razlikuju. Ako iznos nije potvrđen, polje ostavite prazno. Preračunavanje valuta ne čini usporedivima ponude koje obuhvaćaju različite usluge.

corrections.source: Suppose the planning sheet contains an old seller subtotal of 220, domestic delivery of 10 and an outbound estimate of 145. The initial overall figure is 375. During packing the buyer adds a separately purchased accessory. Its purchase and domestic movement have already been recorded elsewhere. The outbound box also changes: the final freight line is 153 and the packing service line is 9. The new outbound total is 162. Comparing 162 with 145 gives a 17-unit change on the parcel side.
corrections.translation: U početnoj tablici roba stoji 220, domaća dostava 10, a procjena međunarodnog prijevoza iznosi 145. Početni ukupni iznos je 375. Tijekom pakiranja kupac dodaje zasebno kupljen dodatak, čija su kupnja i domaća dostava već zabilježene drugdje. Mijenja se i vanjska kutija. Konačni prijevoz iznosi 153, a pakiranje 9, pa novi trošak međunarodne pošiljke iznosi 162. U odnosu na raniju procjenu od 145, trošak na strani paketa porastao je za 17.
